provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: El'dravire Riverrealm occupies 6,815,430.47 sq mi / 17,651,883.88 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 3.460707% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Beach and grass with water, Partial forest and Beach and reefs with water define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Beach and grass with water, Farming, Marshes and swamps, Beach and reefs with water and Ocean Surface floating settlement. Population density is 7.559 people/sq km / 19.578 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, Fey and Trickster Folk, and 2 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Harengon, Elf — Wood Elf, Elf — Eladrin, Fey-Folk — Faerie, Satyr, Changeling, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Black-Maw Myriad, with worship and patronage records naming Nebyrr, Ishtanora, Iskareth, Thoryn-Rahek, Bastveig, Sigrananna, Hathruna, and 3 more.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.groupLinkDescription: The province participates in 6 recorded four-province geography group links, including 5 cross-transportation-group links. npcs.name: Shawnie
npcs.description:
Shawnie is a bright, anxious, endlessly curious Wechselkind child-construct who loves taking things apart, but only because they want to understand how to make them safer, kinder, or more useful. As a Wechselkind, they/he was made for adaptation and shifting function, carrying Setrimir’s influence through artificial life, awakened machinery, stolen knowledge, and the painful question of whether a built child is allowed to choose who they become.
At the Lorangriel Transit Yard, Shawnie accepts harmless errands for scrap, broken tools, clockwork bits, damaged lenses, empty vials, transit tags, and safe relic fragments, then turns them into small gifts or useful devices for the person who helped them. They/he absolutely despises Taska Thistleglimmer, not because Shawnie lacks curiosity, but because Taska keeps sending people into danger to satisfy it; to Shawnie, discovery is only worthwhile if everyone comes home with all their fingers, memories, and souls still attached. Lorangriel is the capital of El'dravire Riverrealm, giving Shawnie a major transit hub full of salvage, travelers, and Glasswell Institute oversight to quietly study.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Lorangriel is a Capital City in El'dravire Riverrealm, under Parliamentary Government, with high danger, Beach and grass with water, Farming, Beach and reefs with water terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Wechselkind reads through the Wechselkind entry of the race compendium, within Constructed and Artificial Beings, marked by Setrimir. Shapeshifting construct-children designed for adaptation and infiltration, Wechselkind can alter their appearance and function. They are adaptive, secretive, and often uncertain of their “true” self. Table cues: +2 Constitution, +1 Charisma, Artificial Form, Faerie Glamour; starting tendency Altruistic - Lawful - Neutral - Honorable.
